column3: Don't shoot! Don't shoot! It wasn't me, I swear!
column4: لا تطلق! لا تطلق! مو أنا، والله!

column3: ...Do what?
There's so many of them with my face... but I'm not one of them! Please!
column4: في واجد منهم بوجهي... بس أنا مو منهم! تكفى!

column3: You locked me in that store.
No, no, no. That was one of them. Look, no knife.
column4: لا لا لا. هذاك واحد منهم. شوف، ما معي سكين.

column3: Who are you?
Um...
I'm Khalid.
...Doesn't matter who I am.
What happened here?
Nobody knows.
Don't read those out loud. Something always answers.
column4: لا تقرا هذي بصوت عالي. دايمًا في شي يرد.

column3: I'm looking for a boy. He had a backpack.
...Is he yours?
...He's my brother.
Then I hope you find him. He went toward the school.
column4: الله يعينك تلقاه. راح صوب المدرسة.

column3: But don't go into the alley there. People go in. They don't come out.
column4: بس لا تدخل السكة اللي هناك. الناس يدخلون. وما يطلعون.

column3: I have to.
No. You don't.
Move.
Can't you hear me?! I'm telling you, you'll die in there!
Let go of me.
For what?! For a kid who's probably already—
column4: عشان إيش؟! عشان ولد يمكن أصلًا—

column3: Then I hope you find him. Where did you see him?
In the alley by the school. I just came from there.
column4: في السكة اللي عند المدرسة. توني طالع منها.

column3: ...You went in there? And you came back out?
Yeah.
Nobody comes back out of there.
I did.
...Then something let you.
I'm going back. The boy went that way.
No. Whatever let you out won't do it twice.
column4: لا. اللي خلاك تطلع ما راح يسويها مرتين.

column3: Move.
Can't you hear me?! You got lucky! You'll die in there!
column4: ما تسمع؟! انت محظوظ! بتموت هناك!

column3: Let go of me.
For what?! For a kid who's probably already—
column4: عشان إيش؟! عشان ولد يمكن أصلًا—

column3: ...Fine. Go. Don't say I didn't warn you.
I can't stay here.
